keyDates.text: SAVE plan officially ends; 7.5M borrowers must select new repayment plan or face auto-enrollment. Grad PLUS loans eliminated for new borrowers. RAP launches.
One Big Beautiful Bill endowment tax changes take effect for universities with fiscal years starting July 1. Graduated rates up to 8% kick in for large endowments per student.
Federal FY2026 ends. If agencies do not spend congressionally approved research funds by this date, the majority return to the U.S. Treasury.
568 Cartel financial aid antitrust trial scheduled to begin for remaining defendants: Cornell, Penn, MIT, Georgetown, and Notre Dame.
Common App and CSS Profile open for Class of 2031 applicants. Early Decision I deadlines begin in November.
Harvard v. Trump administration: DOJ Title VI antisemitism lawsuit active in federal court. First Circuit appeal of 2025 research funding ruling also ongoing.
Peak F-1/J-1 student visa processing season. State Dept. FIFA PASS system is prioritizing World Cup visitor visas over student visa appointments, raising fall 2026 enrollment concerns.
First Circuit oral arguments expected in government appeal of Judge Burroughs' Sept. 2025 ruling restoring Harvard's $2B+ in federal research funding.
